# A proposed partnership between sgit.ai and DigitalOcean

**DigitalOcean is the shortest path from "I want to try vaults" to a running server.** Spaces is S3-compatible object storage with a built-in CDN, App Platform runs a container, and the DigitalOcean Marketplace explicitly invites open-source projects as 1-Click Apps. For the developers and small teams DigitalOcean serves, a one-click vault server is exactly the right size.

**Nothing on this page is confidential, and there has been no conversation yet.** Every statement about DigitalOcean comes from its own public pages, linked. Every statement about sgit points at the [deployment documentation](../deploy/index.md), a published vault or a page on this site. sgit is Apache-2.0, so DigitalOcean does not need our permission to run it or to build on it. A partnership is about doing that well and together. The general argument is on [the cloud platforms page](cloud-platforms.md).

## In short

- **Everything sgit needs, in the simplest form.** [Spaces](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/spaces) for storage with a CDN, and App Platform for the container.
- **A 1-Click App is the natural listing.** The [DigitalOcean Marketplace](https://marketplace.digitalocean.com/vendors/guidelines-resources) invites open-source projects.
- **The audience fits.** Developers and small teams who want encrypted, versioned data without running a platform.
- **What we would like:** help publishing the 1-Click App, and a tested Spaces deployment.

## How vaults map onto DigitalOcean

| sgit needs | On DigitalOcean | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **A small stateless API** | App Platform, or a Droplet with Docker | Should work: one container. Not tested by us. |
| **Object storage** | Spaces (S3-compatible) | Should work once the S3 endpoint is configurable. Not tested. |
| **Static readers** | Spaces CDN, or App Platform static sites | Should work. Not tested. |

## Where we are with DigitalOcean today

We have not deployed on DigitalOcean yet. It is on this list because it is the platform where a developer is most likely to try something like sgit on a Saturday afternoon, and a 1-Click App is the fastest way to let them.

## What a partnership could be

| Shape | What it would be | On their side |
|---|---|---|
| **1 · A 1-Click App** | The vault server as a DigitalOcean Marketplace 1-Click App, with Spaces for storage. | The Marketplace vendor team. |
| **2 · A tutorial** | A community tutorial: your own encrypted vault server in ten minutes. | DigitalOcean's community content team. |

## What we are asking DigitalOcean for

1. Help publishing a 1-Click App in the [DigitalOcean Marketplace](https://marketplace.digitalocean.com/vendors/guidelines-resources).
2. A test account to verify Spaces with the server.
3. An introduction through [DigitalOcean Startups](https://www.digitalocean.com/startups) or [DigitalOcean Partners](https://www.digitalocean.com/partners).

## What this page does not claim

- **No endorsement.** DigitalOcean has not endorsed sgit, and we have not spoken to anyone there about this. Programme and product descriptions quote DigitalOcean's own pages as of 24 September 2026.
- **Untested.** Nothing on this page has run on DigitalOcean yet.
